prompt: Vertical 9:16 close-up, 135mm f/2, night street. Two gloved fists, lit amber by a TAXI roof sign, clench taut black dividing lines bunched like stretched elastic. Between them, overlapping faces of a flushed, sweaty lad in his early twenties, short dark hair, untucked white going-out shirt, car keys on a lanyard, compress into one startled face, sharp. Behind, soft, the calm figure in a white lab coat. The balaclava has no eye, nose or mouth holes, so no skin shows anywhere; a large white ring is stitched round the whole face, and one small red triangle with rounded corners, pointing down, sits high inside the ring on the right-hand side of the picture. Gloves on both hands; no robot parts. Pink and cyan bokeh, deep blacks, film grain. Thanks.
